    Load up a valuable LISP and type (valret).
The symptom was that the job was killed -- possibly the semantics
of .LOGOUT changed between the initial implementation of VALRET and
now, but in any case, I've fixed it so that (VALRET) is equivalent 
to (VALRET '|:VK |).
